sv.title: Riksgälden: Räkna med budgetunderskott
sv.summary: Riksgäldens nya prognos visar en starkare utveckling av statens finanser än tidigare väntat, men det blir fortsatt stora budgetunderskott de kommande två åren. Dessutom ökar statens refinansieringsbehov 2028.

en.title: National Debt Office: Expect budget deficits
en.summary: The National Debt Office's new forecast shows a stronger development of the state's finances than previously expected, but large budget deficits will continue in the next two years. In addition, the state's refinancing need increases in 2028.
